look_here_first: Start with the flower architecture: nodding red-and-yellow flowers have five long backward-pointing nectar spurs, while the leaves are divided into rounded fan-shaped leaflets. In Central Texas, look in shaded limestone canyon bottoms and mesic cliffs.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: several erect follicles developing after flowering

lookalikes.differences: Five red-and-yellow spurred sepals/petals plus rounded divided leaves are the fast ID package.
